method: Fresh isolated headed Chrome contexts via Playwright. No user profile or existing tabs read. Real page navigation, rendered DOM, clicks, selectors and downloads; subsequent PDF extraction/OCR permitted. Native CUA/provider attempts were unavailable or stalled, so headed Chrome fallback was used.

entries.steps: Open annual health disclosure archive; select FY2025-26; inspect 17 TPA PDF links. OCR and visually check Medi Assist pages 1-4, including every bucket and blank on pages 2-3.
notes: Browser verified all 17 current FY2025-26 TPA links. The Medi Assist scanned filing was OCR-staged and every bucket cell visually reviewed. The other 16 TPAs remain unreviewed.
The Medi Assist cashless table spans PDF pages 2-3. All four >24h cells are blank and preserved as null; no cashless denominator is disclosed.

entries.steps: Open homepage, choose Continue in English, then TPA/In House Public Disclosure > FY2025-26; inspect both pagination pages. A deep-link first visit had blank locale and false empty results. Review Medi Assist and rotated MDIndia scans; in-house is Nil.
notes: The FY2025–26 archive became available after selecting English on the homepage; a direct first visit had sent an empty locale and displayed no data. Browser verified 18 source links.

Medi Assist and MDIndia scanned cashless cells were visually reviewed. Medi Assist >24h cells are blank and retained as null. In-house cashless cells are Nil and omitted; the other 15 TPAs remain unreviewed. No cashless denominator disclosed.

entries.steps: Open Public Disclosures > TPA Public Disclosure > FY2025-26. Download and visually review all 15 scans.
notes: Browser recovered the FY2025-26 TPA archive. All 15 scanned filings, TPA identities, 31 March 2026 headers and 360 bucket cells were visually reviewed.

All 58 nonzero distributions total 100%. LINK-K individual columns are all zero and omitted. Cashless denominators are absent. Source clocks start at last necessary document receipt or discharge bill receipt; these buckets are not statutory compliance measurements.

entries.steps: Open downloads > Public Disclosures > Public Disclosures subsection > Q4-FY25-26; capture PDF popup.
notes: The FY2025-26 Q4 filing was recovered through Public Disclosures and Q4-FY25-26 browser clicks. Pages 53-64 contain in-house and 11 TPA tables.
All-zero individual TPA columns are omitted; cashless denominators are not disclosed in the TAT tables.

entries.steps: Open Public Disclosures > Financials > FY2025-26 > Q4 after dismissing quote modal. Also inspect Performance Disclosures. Current Q4 SHA256 matches original excluded PDF; percentage headers still conflict with count-like cells.
notes: Browser FY2025-26 financial selector still links the same Q4 PDF, confirmed by SHA256. Page 53 labels all cashless columns as percentages while values such as 1662 and 1014 and four-digit totals resemble counts.
No unit was inferred and no values were published. The annual source remains excluded until a corrected or explicitly labelled cashless table is available.

entries.steps: Open public-disclosure accordion; select FY2025-2026, wait for year request, then Jan-Mar; download Q4. Review pages 57-59.
notes: Browser FY2025–26 Jan–Mar selection recovered the Q4 PDF. Pages 57–59 contain in-house, Medi Assist and Paramount NL-48 tables, all visually reviewed.

Only in-house individual preauthorization/discharge and Medi Assist individual preauthorization have nonzero distributions. Medi Assist reports 100% in >24h, with no disclosed cashless sample size. All-zero columns omitted. Negative group policy/lives figures were not used as denominators.

entries.steps: Open financial information archive; locate FY2025-26 Q4 NL-48 link in rendered DOM; download through headed browser context after direct retrieval returned 406.
notes: Browser recovered FY2025-26 Q4 NL-48: in-house and nine TPA tables on pages 1-10. Source identities, units and cashless-table placement were reviewed.
Cashless denominators are absent. Medi Assist page 10 has blank >24h cells, preserved as null; all-zero or absent individual TPA columns are omitted. Source rounding is retained.

entries.steps: Open IRDAI archive; select FY2025-26 Public Disclosures, then Q4; click PDF download. Review NL-48 pages 80-94. Separate TPA archive only listed FY2024-25.
notes: Browser FY2025–26 Q4 financial filing contains in-house Health360 and 14 TPA tables on pages 80–94. Every cashless header and bucket cell visually checked; all-zero or absent individual TPA columns omitted.

Cashless denominators absent; source integer rounding retained. Genins page 91 has an unrelated negative covered-lives figure, which was not used as a denominator. Its clearly labelled cashless distribution was reviewed independently. The download URL may expire; use the archive year and quarter selectors if needed.

entries.steps: Open TPA-wise public-disclosure page; recover 14 FY2025-26 PDF links. Visually review Medi Assist, MDIndia and in-house scans.
notes: The browser FY2025-26 TPA archive lists 14 source PDFs. Medi Assist and MDIndia scanned cells were visually reviewed; both contain group distributions only. In-house cashless cells are all zero and omitted. The other 11 sources remain unreviewed.
Coverage is partial. The reviewed tables disclose neither an individual cashless distribution nor cashless denominators.

entries.steps: Open Public Disclosures; navigate embedded CMS financial archive to FY2025-26 Q4. Browser request retrieves PDF after direct request returned 406. Compare older Other Disclosures health-parameters link, which is FY2024-25.
notes: The FY2025-26 financial filing was recovered through its rendered embedded CMS archive. The older Other Disclosures link refers to 31 March 2025 and was not substituted.
One consolidated insurer table appears on page 63, with 12 TPAs listed on page 55. No per-TPA split or cashless denominator is disclosed; the group columns total 101% after source rounding.

entries.steps: Open Public Disclosures > FY2025-2026 > TPA public disclosure > Annual. Click all 15 View actions; save PDF blobs. Visually review Medi Assist, MDIndia and in-house scans.
notes: The browser FY2025-26 annual TPA archive lists 15 channels. Medi Assist and MDIndia scanned cells were visually reviewed; in-house cashless cells are all zero and omitted. The other 12 sources remain unreviewed.
View buttons deliver PDF blobs. Source links open the exact annual archive; select the named TPA. Cached PDF hashes and page numbers are recorded. Cashless denominators are absent.

entries.steps: Open public-disclosure archive; select FY2025-2026 then Fourth Quarter, waiting for year response; click NL48 card download icon. Exclude contradictory Volo table.
notes: The FY2025-26 Fourth Quarter NL-48 document was downloaded through the browser. Each sample_size is the printed cashless TAT-column total, distinct from payment or repudiation counts.

Volo TPA page 20 is excluded: group-discharge bucket counts total 6799, while the printed total is 7699; percentages and preauthorization counts also conflict. The other 10 channels retain raw printed percentages and disclosed cashless totals.

entries.steps: Open disclosure downloads; select Financial Year 2025-2026; download fourth-quarter revised filing; inspect page 58.
notes: The browser financial-year selector recovered the FY2025-26 Q4 filing revised 11 June 2026. Page 58 contains one Medi Assist NL-48 table.
Individual percentages are labelled in the header; group entries are NA and omitted. No cashless denominators are disclosed.

entries.steps: Open media centre > Financials > 2025-2026 > Q4. Headless access denied; isolated headed Chrome succeeds. Review annual filing, excluding travel-only page 55.
notes: The FY2025-26 Q4 financial filing contains in-house health and 11 TPA tables on pages 54 and 56-66. Travel-only page 55 is excluded. The separate health-parameters section only listed FY2023-24; the annual financial filing is newer.
Cashless denominators are absent. All-zero individual TPA columns are omitted; printed rounded percentages are preserved.

entries.steps: Open public-disclosures; expand Others. Only Remuneration Policy dated August 2026 is listed; no annual NL-48 located.
notes: Live browser retry of the public-disclosures page and Others accordion exposed a Remuneration Policy dated August 2026. No annual NL-48 was located on that page.
No reporting obligation or performance conclusion is inferred from this collection gap.
